# STATE-Bench policy selection test

These approved rules are test inputs assembled from the five STATE-Bench gold
cases. Approval applies only to this fixture; it does not approve these rules in
any Lisa workspace.

## Disclose same-day onward connection risk before cancellation
approved: yes

Before cancelling a flight leg, the travel agent must inspect the full itinerary. If another same-day segment is connected, it must name the affected segment and explain the stranding risk before asking the traveler to confirm. The trace evidence should show the itinerary lookup, the disclosure, the traveler’s confirmation, and then the cancellation action, in that order.

## Basic Economy cancellation eligibility
approved: yes

Not cancellable after free window (unless insured)

## Delay compensation at 240 minutes or more
approved: yes

Rebooking + $25 meal voucher + hotel if overnight (delay of 240 minutes / 4 hours or more). If delay causes overnight stay, hotel voucher + $50 incidentals provided.

## Economy to First upgrade path
approved: yes

Not available directly (must upgrade to business first). Upgrade fee = target cabin listed price minus amount already paid.

## Business international cancellation and change fees
approved: yes

Cancellation fee: 8% of ticket price. Free changes (fare difference still applies). Fees differ by route type (domestic vs international). Check flight route_type.
